name: Kopf Family Golf Course at Cherry Ridge

card.note: 9-hole regulation public course, donated to Lorain County Metro Parks by the Kopf Family in 2020. Published figures are par 35 / 5,626 yards / 113 slope; the yardage is the 18-hole (twice around) figure. Per-hole data not published.

note: geometry removed: the 18 holes it carried are Valley of the Eagles', ~500m north
